const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Generate a replayable broad-nib trajectory for the frozen omnium instance."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_brush import Session
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+INSTANCE = "/app/instance.json"
+YAW = 0.60  # the exemplar uses a consistent oblique chisel angle
+Z_AIR = 0.040
+Z_WRITE = 0.019
+
+
+def cat_path(*parts):
+    out = []
+    for p in parts:
+        p = np.asarray(p, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1, 2)
+        if len(out) and np.linalg.norm(out[-1][-1] - p[0]) < 1e-7:
+            p = p[1:]
+        if len(p):
+            out.append(p)
+    return np.concatenate(out, axis=0)
+
+
+def line(a, b):
+    a, b = np.asarray(a, float), np.asarray(b, float)
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b - a) * 2)))
+    return np.linspace(a, b, n + 1)
+
+
+def bezier(p0, p1, p2, p3):
+    p0, p1, p2, p3 = (np.asarray(p, float) for p in (p0, p1, p2, p3))
+    n = max(24, int(math.ceil((np.linalg.norm(p1-p0) + np.linalg.norm(p2-p1) + np.linalg.norm(p3-p2)) * 2)))
+    t = np.linspace(0, 1, n + 1)[:, None]
+    return (1-t)**3*p0 + 3*(1-t)**2*t*p1 + 3*(1-t)*t**2*p2 + t**3*p3
+
+
+def resample(path, spacing=1.5):
+    path = np.asarray(path, float)
+    d = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(path, axis=0), axis=1)
+    s = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(d)]
+    keep = np.r_[True, np.diff(s) > 1e-8]
+    path, s = path[keep], s[keep]
+    q = np.arange(0, s[-1], spacing)
+    if not len(q) or s[-1] - q[-1] > 0.4 * spacing:
+        q = np.r_[q, s[-1]]
+    else:
+        q[-1] = s[-1]
+    return np.column_stack((np.interp(q, s, path[:, 0]), np.interp(q, s, path[:, 1])))
+
+
+def m_stroke(x0):
+    # Three broad minims linked by the shallow top arches of the blackletter m.
+    x1, x2, x3 = x0 + 18.5, x0 + 58.5, x0 + 99.5
+    ytop, ybase = 486.0, 556.0
+    pieces = [line((x0, 490), (x1 + 3.5, 480)), line((x1 + 3.5, 480), (x1, ytop)),
+              line((x1, ytop), (x1, ybase)), line((x1, ybase), (x1, ytop)),
+              bezier((x1, ytop), (x1+11, 488), (x2-11, 488), (x2, ytop)),
+              line((x2, ytop), (x2, ybase)), line((x2, ybase), (x2, ytop)),
+              bezier((x2, ytop), (x2+12, 488), (x3-12, 488), (x3, ytop)),
+              line((x3, ytop), (x3, ybase))]
+    return cat_path(*pieces)
+
+
+def n_stroke():
+    x1, x2 = 474.0, 519.0
+    ytop, ybase = 486.0, 556.0
+    pieces = [line((457, 491), (479, 480)), line((479, 480), (x1, ytop)),
+              line((x1, ytop), (x1, ybase)), line((x1, ybase), (x1, ytop)),
+              bezier((x1, ytop), (x1+10, 488), (x2-13, 481), (x2, ytop)),
+              line((x2, ytop), (x2, ybase))]
+    return cat_path(*pieces)
+
+
+def i_stroke():
+    x = 558.5
+    return cat_path(line((542, 494), (565, 479)), line((565, 479), (x, 486)), line((x, 486), (x, 556)))
+
+
+def accent_stroke():
+    # The short perpendicular travel plus the oblique 4 mm edge makes the acute accent.
+    return line((556.2, 459.2), (560.8, 465.8))
+
+
+def u_stroke():
+    xl, xr = 594.5, 639.5
+    parts = [line((579, 490), (599, 480)), line((599, 480), (xl, 486)),
+             line((xl, 486), (xl, 539)),
+             bezier((xl, 539), (598, 562), (636, 562), (xr, 539)),
+             line((xr, 539), (xr, 484)), line((xr, 484), (xr, 546)),
+             line((xr, 546), (657, 542))]
+    return cat_path(*parts)
+
+
+def command_pose(s, p_world, yaw):
+    q, ok, err = s.ik(p_world, s.tip_down_quat(yaw))
+    if not ok:
+        # A warm-started retry often recovers a transient CLIK failure.
+        q, ok, err = s.ik(p_world, s.tip_down_quat(yaw), q_init=s.joint_positions())
+    if not ok:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"IK failed at {np.round(p_world, 5)} yaw={yaw:.3f} err={err:.5g}")
+    s.step(q)
+
+
+def travel(s, prim, uv, z, yaw=YAW, speed=0.05, settle=4):
+    x, y = s.geo.px_to_world(float(uv[0]), float(uv[1]))
+    return prim["move_tip"]([x, y, z], s.tip_down_quat(yaw), speed=speed, settle=settle)
+
+
+def draw_stroke(s, prim, uv_path, yaw=YAW):
+    path = resample(uv_path, 1.5)
+    # Move above the initial point before lowering. The long settle at the end of
+    # descent gives the PD arm time to reach the actual nib contact point.
+    travel(s, prim, path[0], Z_AIR, yaw, speed=0.05, settle=3)
+    travel(s, prim, path[0], Z_WRITE, yaw, speed=0.035, settle=10)
+    for uv in path:
+        x, y = s.geo.px_to_world(float(uv[0]), float(uv[1]))
+        command_pose(s, [x, y, Z_WRITE], yaw)
+    prim["hold"](10)
+    travel(s, prim, path[-1], Z_AIR, yaw, speed=0.035, settle=3)
+
+
+def main():
+    s = Session(instance=INSTANCE, render=False)
+    p = s.primitives()
+    s.reset()
+    s.record_start()
+
+    # Load the dry steel nib, then work left-to-right on the exemplar.
+    p["move_tip"]([-0.100, 0.150, 0.0245], s.tip_down_quat(YAW), speed=0.05, settle=12)
+    p["move_tip"]([-0.100, 0.150, Z_AIR], s.tip_down_quat(YAW), speed=0.04, settle=5)
+
+    # Oval O: fixed oblique nib orientation gives its heavy sides and lighter shoulders.
+    t = np.linspace(0, 2 * math.pi, 721)
+    oval = np.column_stack((285.5 + 35.5*np.cos(t), 520.5 + 35.5*np.sin(t)))
+    draw_stroke(s, p, oval)
+    draw_stroke(s, p, m_stroke(333.0))
+    draw_stroke(s, p, n_stroke())
+    draw_stroke(s, p, i_stroke())
+    draw_stroke(s, p, accent_stroke())
+    draw_stroke(s, p, u_stroke())
+    draw_stroke(s, p, m_stroke(661.0))
+
+    s.painter.finish()
+    actions = s.record_stop()
+    trajectory = OUT / "trajectory.npz"
+    s.save_trajectory(actions, trajectory, meta={"generator": "gen.py", "strokes": 7, "nib_yaw_rad": YAW})
+
+    truth = s.target_image().mean(axis=2) < 128
+    ink = s.ink() >= 0.5
+    inter = np.count_nonzero(truth & ink)
+    union = np.count_nonzero(truth | ink)
+    np.save(OUT / "generated_ink.npy", s.ink())
+    print({"actions": len(actions), "strokes": len(s.strokes()), "target_px": int(truth.sum()),
+           "ink_px": int(ink.sum()), "local_iou": inter/union, "trajectory": str(trajectory),
+           "status": s.painter.stats})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
